required_paths: all 48 journey result paths resolved from journey-matrix.csv

evidence_record_minimum.inputs: fixture references and hashes, not secrets

redaction_rules: Never store raw passwords, activation tokens, session cookies, CSRF values, API keys, provider secrets, authorization headers, or database URLs.
Store only synthetic .example.test identifiers from fixtures.synthetic.json.
Store provider references as opaque digests; provider URLs are forbidden in provider-off baseline.
Screenshots must not contain real-user or production data.
index_rules: Every evidence file except checksums.sha256 appears once in evidence-index.json.
Every indexed SHA-256 matches bytes on disk.
Every journey, gate, action, role/state, viewport/mode, and reset evidence reference resolves.
The final report validates against evidence.schema.json.
